summary: Shows how to list WinRM listeners with winrm enumerate, explains the Transport, Port and CertificateThumbprint fields, and how to inspect the certificate by thumbprint.
questions: How do I check which WinRM listeners are configured on a host?
How can I see which certificate my WinRM HTTPS listener uses?
What are the default WinRM ports?

answer_card.title: Listing WinRM listeners
answer_card.answer_md:
```powershell
winrm enumerate winrm/config/Listener
```

Key fields: `Transport` (HTTP or HTTPS), `Port` (defaults 5985 HTTP / 5986 HTTPS), and `CertificateThumbprint` (HTTPS cert). Inspect the cert:

```powershell
Get-Item -Path "Cert:\LocalMachine\My\$thumbprint" | Select-Object *
```
